budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Two controlled hunters seek a capture; the controlled evader seeks an explicit gate escape after tick eight. Scans exchange energy and concealment for imperfect persistent contacts.
task.natural_termination: Explicit hunter tag within Manhattan one after movement causes capture; otherwise explicit evader action at open gate causes escape. Capture takes precedence if simultaneous. H=48 is only truncation, not evader victory.
task.interaction: Costly scans reveal the scanner current position for two ticks while obtaining nearest radius-five echo; a physical decoy can replace the true contact. A relay copies contact information to the teammate without refreshing age. Movement, cloak, decoys and explicit capture alter interception opportunities.
task.observation_access: Map/gate and scan broadcasts are public. Agents use Manhattan local sight two, reduced to one for cloaked evader; active scanner beacons reveal their position globally. Contact records are receiver-private. Scene uses exactly these native masks and never reveals hidden evader or unseen decoy.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Hunter deliberately broadcast a scan this transition
Controlled evader captured by explicit adjacent tag
Controlled evader explicitly escaped through open gate

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
